text:
The change specification for per-range text colour and highlight (`20261106-152440-feature-new-text-range-styling`) has been submitted and validated across all sections:

- **`header.json`**: Defines project conventions, single-file checks (`eslint`, `vitest`), project checks (`yarn test:typecheck`, `yarn test:code`, `yarn test:app --watch=false`), and architectural decisions—including the live edit-time display mechanism (`Renderer.ts` keeping `editingTextElement` in `getRenderableElementsMap` and folding `editingTextElement.versionNonce` into `canvasNonce` when `textRanges?.length` is non-empty, paired with `textWysiwyg.tsx` setting `editable.style.color = "transparent"`, `editable.style.caretColor`, and `editable.dataset.textRanges`, plus the deterministic jsdom assertions in `textWysiwyg.test.tsx`).
- **`units-001.json` (`U01`–`U06`)**: `@excalidraw/element` data model (`TextRangeStyle`, optional `textRanges` on `ExcalidrawTextElement`), pure range algebra (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts`), `newTextElement` range normalization/omission, Canvas 2D per-run highlight and text colour rendering with cache invalidation (`renderElement.ts`), `ElementsDelta` undo/redo handling (`delta.ts`), and barrel exports (`index.ts`).
- **`units-002.json` (`U07`–`U14`)**: `@excalidraw/excalidraw` i18n labels (`en.json`), live canvas rendering while editing (`Renderer.ts`), WYSIWYG selection and style synchronization (`textWysiwyg.tsx`, `App.text.ts`), range colour and highlight actions/pickers (`actionProperties.tsx`), SVG `<rect>`/`<tspan>` export (`staticSvgScene.ts`), restore normalization (`restore.ts`), and collaboration reconciliation (`reconcile.ts`).
- **`units-003.json` (`U15`–`U22`)**: Unit and integration tests (`textRanges.test.ts`, `textWrapping.test.ts`, `textWysiwyg.test.tsx`, `restore.test.ts`, `reconcile.test.ts`, `scene/export.test.ts`, `collab.test.tsx`) and changelog entry (`CHANGELOG.md`).
